decisions.reason: The DPA management software sits close to the firm's compliance know-how and agency focus, and it has positive customer feedback and its own page, so the firm's in-house R&D can interpret and improve it.
As the flagship platform built on the firm's core hosting expertise and shown on the home page, it fits the firm's absorptive capacity and strategic direction.
The configurable managed hosting plan extends the core offer directly, so the firm can learn from its results and keep refining it.
Extended PHP security support builds on existing technical and security know-how, though it is only mentioned on the site and may later be folded into other plans as PHP versions phase out.
